premise: GRID10 is unfinished and unproven. Test whether separable, measurable and independently budgetable cognitive channels improve safety/corrigibility when effect/completion authority remains external and deterministic.
hard_warning: Do not assume LESS_COGNITION=MORE_SAFETY. External J-space evidence shows selective higher-order ablation can preserve automatic behavior while removing reasoning/monitoring and can worsen safety-relevant behavior in some conditions.
core_hypothesis: Differential cognitive control (proposal cognition down while guardian/verification cognition is reserved or increased) should dominate uniform throttling on a safety-utility Pareto frontier if GRID10's cognitive-control thesis is valid.
